summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of requisite consents and expiration of consent solicitations for six series of senior notes totaling $1.029 billion. Holders approved indenture amendments, each receiving a $1.00 per $1,000 consent fee. These amendments are part of Teck's merger of equals with Anglo American, expected to close between September 2026 and March 2027. The consent fees are payable regardless of merger completion, and the consent solicitations are not a condition to the merger. Watch for regulatory approvals and merger completion conditions.
